title: Blood Cell Flow Capillary Network Simulation
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with an interactive 3D blood cell flow simulation through a capillary network using Three.js and GLTFLoader.

## Scene Setup
- Use a dark reddish-black background (0x1a0505) to evoke the interior of a blood vessel.
- Camera: PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 15, 30), looking at origin. Attach OrbitControls for user navigation.
- Lighting: One warm directional light (0xffccaa) from above-right, one dim ambient light (0x331111), and a point light (0xff4444) that follows the camera to illuminate nearby cells.
- Load the 'Xbot.glb' model using GLTFLoader. Scale it to (0.3, 0.3, 0.3) and position it at (0, -2, 0). This represents a 'nanobot observer' stationed inside the capillary. Play its idle animation if available using THREE.AnimationMixer.

## Capillary Network
- Generate a branching capillary network using THREE.TubeGeometry along CatmullRomCurve3 paths.
- Create a main trunk path from (-30, 0, 0) to (30, 0, 0) with gentle sinusoidal undulation in Y.
- At x=-10, branch into an upper path curving to (30, 8, 5) and a lower path curving to (30, -6, -3).
- At x=5 on the main trunk, add another branch curving to (30, 3, -8).
- Capillary walls: semi-transparent red material (0xcc2222, opacity 0.15, side: DoubleSide) with tube radius 1.5.
- Store all branch paths in an array for cell routing.

## Blood Cells
- Simulate 3 types of blood cells as sphere-based meshes:
  1. Red Blood Cells (RBC): flattened spheres (scaleY=0.35), color 0xcc0000, count=40
  2. White Blood Cells (WBC): slightly larger spheres, color 0xeeeedd, count=6
  3. Platelets: tiny spheres (scale 0.3), color 0xffcc66, count=15
- Each cell has: position along a path (parametric t from 0 to 1), assigned branch index, speed (base + random variance), and a slight random wobble offset perpendicular to the path.
- When a cell reaches t>=1.0, it wraps back to t=0 and may randomly reassign to a different branch (30% chance).

## Flow Physics
- Base flow speed: 0.002 per frame. Each cell gets speed = baseSpeed * (0.8 + Math.random()*0.4).
- Implement a global flowRate multiplier (default 1.0) that scales all cell speeds.
- Cells should wobble sinusoidally perpendicular to their path: amplitude 0.3, frequency based on cell index.
- Track total distance traveled by all cells combined (sum of delta-t * pathLength each frame).
- Enforce: no cell position may be NaN; all cells must remain within 3.0 units of their assigned path centerline.

## User Interactions
- Keyboard 'ArrowUp': increase flowRate by 0.2 (max 3.0)
- Keyboard 'ArrowDown': decrease flowRate by 0.2 (min 0.1)
- Keyboard 'Space': toggle pause/resume of the simulation
- Keyboard '1': highlight only RBCs (set WBC and platelet opacity to 0.15)
- Keyboard '2': highlight only WBCs (set RBC and platelet opacity to 0.15)
- Keyboard '3': highlight only Platelets (set RBC and WBC opacity to 0.15)
- Keyboard '0': reset all cell opacities to 1.0
- A DOM button with id='inject-wbc' that, when clicked, spawns 3 additional WBCs at t=0 on the main trunk branch.

## HUD / UI
- A top-left HUD overlay (id='hud') showing:
  - Current flowRate (id='hud-flow-rate')
  - Total cell count (id='hud-cell-count')
  - Simulation status: 'RUNNING' or 'PAUSED' (id='hud-status')
  - Total distance traveled (id='hud-distance'), formatted to 1 decimal
- The inject button (id='inject-wbc') styled as a red pill-shaped button at bottom-center.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields, updated every frame:
- flowRate: number (current flow multiplier)
- paused: boolean
- totalCells: number (total active cells)
- rbcCount: number
- wbcCount: number
- plateletCount: number
- totalDistanceTraveled: number (cumulative)
- highlightMode: string ('all'|'rbc'|'wbc'|'platelet')
- xbotLoaded: boolean (true once GLB loads)
- branchCount: number (number of capillary branches)
- cellPositionsValid: boolean (true if no cell has NaN position)
- maxDeviationFromPath: number (largest perpendicular distance any cell is from its path center)
- animationMixerActive: boolean (true if Xbot animation mixer is updating)
- frameCount: number (incremented each animation frame)
- injectedWBCCount: number (total WBCs injected via button, starts at 0)
physics_constraints: All cell positions must remain NaN-free at all times. Cells must stay within 3.0 units of their assigned capillary path centerline. flowRate must be clamped between 0.1 and 3.0. Total cell count must equal rbcCount + wbcCount + plateletCount. totalDistanceTraveled must be monotonically non-decreasing when not paused. When paused, no cell positions should change and totalDistanceTraveled must remain constant.
